title: Fasten a spring-loaded access plate while maintaining its preload
instruction: Press the grey access plate level while turning the three orange nuts down their studs. Retain the centre of the flat plate 14 mm above the tabletop (within 1 mm), level within 0.035 radians. Keep the plate controlled as the nuts capture its spring load. Seat every nut against the plate, then withdraw both hands.
context: Three non-collinear fasteners capture the vertical preload and two-axis attitude of a spring-loaded access plate. One arm controls the plate while the other establishes real helical engagement and repeatedly regrips each nut.
setup: Bimanual YAM station, fixed layout and seed 0. Positions are metres, x forward, y left, z up. Tabletop z=0.7475. bracket is steel plate and threaded studs, mass 0.6 kg, collision envelope (0.25, 0.17, 0.047) m, initial position (0.265, 0, 0.7515000000000001), XYZW (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0). plate_carrier is rigid material, mass 0.001 kg, collision envelope (0.001, 0.001, 0.001) m, initial position (0.265, 0, 0.7735000000000001), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). plate_gimbal is rigid material, mass 0.001 kg, collision envelope (0.001, 0.001, 0.001) m, initial position (0.265, 0, 0.7735000000000001), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). pressure_plate is rigid material, mass 0.12 kg, collision envelope (0.25, 0.266, 0.032) m, initial position (0.265, 0, 0.7735000000000001), XYZW (0, 0, 0, 1). nut_0 is coarse threaded steel surrogate, mass 0.024 kg, collision envelope (0.034, 0.034, 0.01) m, initial position (0.15, -0.18, 0.7527), XYZW (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0). nut_1 is coarse threaded steel surrogate, mass 0.024 kg, collision envelope (0.034, 0.034, 0.01) m, initial position (0.36, -0.18, 0.7527), XYZW (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0). nut_2 is coarse threaded steel surrogate, mass 0.024 kg, collision envelope (0.034, 0.034, 0.01) m, initial position (0.22, 0.23, 0.7527), XYZW (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0).
scoring: 0.2 for each of three correctly threaded nuts at its numeric seated pose, with at least3.4 measured turns and matching4mm pitch advance. 0.4 for retaining plate preload and attitude after all three nuts complete at least3.45 real turns. Full score requires the existing two-second released-hand stability hold. Dislodged goals lose credit. Invalid physics, lost parts or broken fixture preservation permanently score zero. Complete numeric predicates are in scene.json and SCORING.md.
run_limit: 18,000 control steps (900 simulated seconds at 20 Hz)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: 4-mm-lead square threads use 16 rigid contact sectors per turn, 1.70-mm axial tooth thickness, 0.60-mm nominal axial backlash and 0.90-mm radial engagement. A vertical spring and two passive tilt joints model the access plate. Rigid-contact helix faces approximate manufactured thread flanks. Scoring measures pitch-coupled rotation and retained plate compression.
